The ARDSNet high PEEP table was never applied; the paper only compares the PL-set PEEP with what the table would have recommended. The comparator actually run is pre-balloon usual care.
No reason is recorded for contacting the authors; the protocol appendix is published online and every pooled number is in Tables 2-3.
The paper makes no statement that the balloon or manometry caused, or did not cause, complications; the adverse events are not attributed to the balloon. Silence is null.
48 is the count of balloons placed hospital-wide in the period (19 in patients not meeting inclusion); attempts are never reported in this retrospective series.

48 counts balloons placed in all patients hospital-wide, including 19 outside the study population; for the 29 included, placement was an inclusion condition. A co-author should decide between 29 (derived: inclusion required a placed balloon) and null.
'Median days of mechanical ventilation prior to balloon insert were 1 day' is a reported interval from intubation; recorded as reported, in days, with no conversion.
One titration strategy (End Exp PL approaching 0 +/- 2); the End Insp PL > 20 cm H2O rule is a safety limit within that strategy, not a second target strategy.
